batches.name: Deterministic CMS Configuration
entryCriteria: RB-001 through RB-009 applicable preconditions completed
Fresh read-only evidence still matches this preflight
Named CMS administrator and rollback operator assigned
excluded: Taxonomy term deletion without separate explicit rollback/deletion authorization
Accessibility alt text without approved wording/decorative decision
batches.stopCondition: Stop on evidence drift, missing backup evidence, duplicate term slug, unexpected field ownership, any need for backend/schema change, or any rollback that would require taxonomy deletion without separate explicit rollback/deletion authorization.

batches.name: Independent Front Page and Navigation Configuration
entryCriteria: Four tenant-local homepage records and their content are explicitly approved
Fifteen tenant-local menu structures, labels, destinations, targets, legal links, and locale policy are approved
All resulting Page and Menu databaseIds are recorded before assignment
Separate CMS mutation authorization and rollback evidence exist
batches.stopCondition: Stop if any tenant lacks an approved local record, if a destination is unsafe/unknown, or if configuration would cross tenant boundaries.

batches.name: Authoritative Launch Content and Accessibility
entryCriteria: Named editorial approvers for Group and each branch
Record-level content authority decisions and approved final copy/media
Approved accessibility text or decorative decisions
Separate CMS mutation authorization and rollback evidence
batches.stopCondition: Stop if launch authority is absent, a private/restricted record appears, a relationship truncates, or required content would need to be invented.

batches.name: Post-Remediation Read-Only Verification
entryCriteria: An authorized mutation batch completed without unresolved failure
Execution ledger contains all affected and created databaseIds
checks: Compare exact affected coordinates with before-state evidence
Classify each action as VALIDATED_UNCHANGED, CHANGED_AS_EXPECTED, DRIFT_DETECTED, EVIDENCE_UNKNOWN, or BLOCKED_BY_SOT_001
Accept CHANGED_AS_EXPECTED only when current evidence matches the accepted expected state; treat any other baseline change as DRIFT_DETECTED
Require zero truncation and safe public links/media
Confirm tenant isolation and exact Business Unit slugs
Confirm content authority independently from technical validity
batches.stopCondition: Do not advance if any check fails or evidence is UNKNOWN.

batches.name: Deferred Architecture-Dependent Work
entryCriteria: Localization ownership and route model approved
Step 3 SEO/preview contracts implemented and accepted
batches.stopCondition: No CMS values may be populated from guesses, prototype dictionaries, or unimplemented contracts.
